title: Emojis as Anchors to Detect Arabic Offensive Language and Hate Speech
findings: In the analyzed dataset of hateful Arabic tweets, Jews were the most frequent target of religious prejudice (39% of religious hate speech tweets), followed by Muslims, Christians, and Shia.
